Visa de Turista (T) - Embajada de la Republica Bolivariana de Venezuela en Colombia

docs.text: Passport (original and copy) valid for at least six months
Two recent color passport-size photos, front-facing
Medical certificate issued by the health authority of the country of origin
Proof of payment of the consular fee (amount confirmed with the embassy or consulate)
Proof of residence in the country of origin
Bank letter (account opening date, number and balance)
Employment letter (tenure, position and salary)
Copy of round-trip or onward ticket
Hotel reservation or notarized invitation letter

Visas - Embajada de la Republica Bolivariana de Venezuela en Colombia

docs.text: Passport (original and copy) valid for at least six months
Two recent color passport-size photos, front-facing
Medical certificate issued by the health authority of the country of origin
Proof of payment of the consular fee (amount confirmed with the embassy or consulate)
TR-N: letter from the applicant or sponsoring company stating the purpose of the trip and a contact address in Venezuela
TR-N: commercial registry document or letter from a chamber of commerce, industry or trade association
TR-I: Investor Certificate processed through the Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior

links.title: MPPRE | Ministerio del Poder Popular para Relaciones Exteriores y Comercio Internacional
Visa de Transeúnte Laboral (TR-L) - Embajada de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela en Colombia

docs.text: Passport (original and copy) valid for at least six months
Two recent color passport-size photos, front-facing
Medical certificate issued by the health authority of the country of origin
Proof of payment of the consular fee (amount confirmed with the embassy or consulate)
Certified copy of the work permit issued by Venezuela's labour ministry
Documents proving professional qualification (degrees, work experience certificates)
Criminal record certificate from the country of origin, issued within three months, apostilled or legalized and translated into Spanish

Visa de Transeúnte Estudiante (TR-E) - Embajada de la Republica Bolivariana de Venezuela en Colombia

docs.text: Passport (original and copy) valid for at least six months
Two recent color passport-size photos, front-facing
Medical certificate issued by the health authority of the country of origin
Proof of payment of the consular fee (amount confirmed with the embassy or consulate)
Acceptance letter from the school or internship company
Letter from the sponsoring institution stating the student's financial means in Venezuela
Degrees and/or study certificates

Visa de Transeúnte Familiar Venezolano (TR-FV) - Embajada de la Republica Bolivariana de Venezuela en Colombia

docs.text: Passport (original and copy) valid for at least six months
Two recent color passport-size photos, front-facing
Medical certificate issued by the health authority of the country of origin
Proof of payment of the consular fee (amount confirmed with the embassy or consulate)
Documents proving the family relationship with the Venezuelan citizen (birth or marriage certificate)
Familiar Migrante Permanente: copy of the resident relative's passport and visa
Spouse of a Venezuelan: marriage certificate registered in Venezuela, including marriages held abroad (renewal at SAIME)
